entry.desc: Tuning factor for stratiform in-cloud scavenging of cloud-borne aerosols. CAM default for cam6/cam7 (CLUBB with MG2/MG3 microphysics) is 1.0.

Tuning factor for below-cloud scavenging of interstitial aerosols. The default -1.0D30 is the NOTSET sentinel: like CAM (which never sets this variable through build-namelist), the scheme then uses the hygroscopicity-weighted per-mode solubility from the aerosol state (aero_state%sol_factb_interstitial) instead of a constant.
Tuning factor for convective in-cloud scavenging of interstitial aerosols. CAM default is 0.4.

Weight the deep and shallow convective in-cloud condensate by their cloud fractions when forming the convective in-cloud water seen by wet deposition (the Sungsu Dec-2009 formulation), instead of a simple sum. Replaces CAM's cam_physpkg_is('cam5'|'cam6') branch in wetdep_inputs_set: .true. reproduces cam5/cam6 physics, .false. reproduces cam7.
